Hi Olivia,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off onboarding with Redwood. I'm Alex on the procurement team — I will be your primary contact for vendor setup and POs. To get the supplier record created and payments flowing, we need a few items from Veridian. Can you please provide the following at your earliest convenience?

Required items (we can accept PDFs/photos/scans):
- Legal entity full name and any DBA names
- Registered address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Tax identifier (EIN/TIN for US entities or equivalent for non-US) and completed tax form (W-9 for US, W-8BEN/W-8BEN-E for non-US)
- Remit-to instructions (name on account, remit address if different from legal address)
- Bank details for ACH: bank name, account number, routing number (or IBAN/SWIFT for international wires)
- Payee contact for PO and invoice routing (name, email, phone)
- Copy of a bank letter or voided check for account verification (preferred for ACH onboarding)
- Certificate of incorporation or similar proof of entity (for legal)

Optional but helpful: estimated monthly spend band, preferred payment terms (Net 30/45), and a sample invoice PDF so we can validate PO-to-invoice matching fields.

Attached is our supplier intake worksheet (fillable). If it's easier, you can return answers inline in a reply and attach the supporting docs. Our typical internal target is to have vendor created in NetSuite within 3 business days after all docs are received.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll route the documents to Finance (Marcus) and Legal (Markus) for verification.
- Once validated, Finance will send an ACH enrollment confirmation and expected first payment date.

If you have any questions about international wire formatting or withholding, let me know — happy to hop on a short call.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Olivia — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. I reviewed with Finance and Legal; a couple quick clarifications so we can close out vendor creation today: 

1) Bank account: please send either a voided check PDF or a bank letter that explicitly shows the full account number (the letter you sent masks the account for security). Finance needs that to enable ACH.
2) Wire fallback: Finance can process a one-time wire if you prefer payment before ACH enrollment; wires incur a $25 outbound fee. Let me know if Veridian wants Redwood to absorb (we can consider absorbing for the first payment) or if you'd prefer to receive via wire with the fee deducted.
3) 1099 preference: we only require a standard W-9 for a U.S. entity; 1099 distribution will follow year-end based on payments. No separate 1099 preference form required at onboarding.

Next steps:
- Olivia: send voided check or bank letter with full account number and confirm acceptance of wire fee policy (absorb vs pass-through).
- Marcus: please provision the vendor in NetSuite as "Pending ACH Verification" and queue for ACH once we receive the full account proof.
- Markus: please confirm by EOD that the Certificate of Incorporation + W-9 satisfy our legal checklist for US suppliers.

I'll attach the completed SupplierOnboardingForm_filled.pdf and add DocuSign invite if any additional signatures are required. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765 — I added account notes and expected go-live ETA (pending bank verification).

Thanks all — aiming to have vendor active by next week if we receive the bank documentation today.

Best,
